clusters.name: After the birth of your sister Bea, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Within about a year and a half of your sister Bea's birth in March 1995, your mother was worn out and on edge with the baby, your father and mother grew distant with him working late and rarely home, you had stomach aches and missed school, your father and brother had shouting matches, and your mother did not go back to her job — these fall close together, a few months apart each time, and may point to a broader process moving in the family around the new baby.
